facts.value: According to Durkheim, Buddhism is a religion that admits the existence of sacred things, namely, the four noble truths and the practices derived from them.
Hinduism is variously defined as a religion, set of religious beliefs and practices, and religious tradition.
Three gods, Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, and other deities are considered manifestations of and are worshipped as incarnations of Brahman.
Members of various Hindu sects worship a variety of specific deities and follow numerous rites in honor of specific gods.
The profusion of forms and practices in Hinduism is seen by practitioners as expressions of the same unchanging reality.
Many Hindus are monotheistic in that they recognize only one Supreme Being, a God or Goddess who is the source and ruler of the devas.
